csv_scope_of_work: Garfield County is soliciting interest from consulting firms with expertise in Civil Engineering Design for preparing plans and specifications for striping of paved county roads. All services will follow the Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) standards and procedures for Local Agencies in accordance with WSDOT Local Agency Guideline (LAG) Manual. This agreement will be for approximately thirty-six (36) months duration with the option for Garfield County to extend it for additional time and fees if necessary.
